_doc: Claims profile for scripts/check_copy.py: the Amazon image-copy rules that hold in every category.
banned: regex patterns grouped by reason. Each match in a free text key is an error. Patterns run on the normalized text (ASCII apostrophes, hyphens and spaces) and ignore case.
warnings: regex patterns grouped by reason. Each match is a warning for a human to check, not an error.
A category profile names this file in its own extends key ("extends": "amazon-standard") and adds its groups; groups and patterns are merged in order and a repeated pattern counts once.
Scalar keys (disclaimer, headline_words, eyebrow_caps, no_text_frames) are taken from the most specific profile that sets them.
disclaimer: null here. A category whose structure/function lines need a fixed disclaimer sets {key, prefix, name}.
headline_words: a headline outside min..max words is a warning that names the aim range.
eyebrow_caps: true warns when an eyebrow is not written in capitals.
no_text_frames: frame ids that must carry no text at all; Amazon's MAIN image is product only.
A product's facts file can lift a banned pattern with allow when the claim is approved for that product.
name: amazon-standard
